query_plan_findings.plan: SCAN preprocess_job_status USING COVERING INDEX idx_admin_preprocess_job_failed

changes: Reused one SQLite connection inside readAdminPreprocessJobManifestPageFromStore for status metadata and page rows.
Extracted shared statusFromMetadata freshness logic so the public status reader and the page reader use the same freshness contract.
Removed global preprocess_job_status COUNT(*) from the preprocess job page hot path.
Kept global snapshot row-count mismatch detection in process-history readiness and other diagnostic paths.
Added a focused test proving the page hot path can return current-page ready snapshots while readiness still reports table_row_count_mismatch.

remaining_gaps: preprocess_job_page still spends about 147ms on SMB SQLite reads and can be considered for a short TTL read-model page cache only if route refresh behavior requires it.
source-videos status routes still need component-level timings before deeper query changes.
Dashboard production_summary still costs about 367ms and should be inspected separately.
This slice does not complete Protection Gate coverage, frontend loading architecture, redundancy cleanup, or Docker release gates.
